rules.source: NHS symptom guidance is contextual; not medical diagnosis.

rules.when: A critical data-quality issue or historical policy-reference mismatch is present.
Unusual fatigue or a reported interruption is present.
rules.source: Risk literature supports caution, not a numeric rule.

rules.when: Any scheduled outcome is unreported or a required performance fact is unknown.
rules.source: Missing data is not successful completion.

rules.when: Two or more current completed/partial outcomes report too_difficult in the reviewed window.
rules.fallback: A lower prescription is not authored; no change request.

rules.when: A reported partial or missed outcome has no health concern or critical data issue.
rules.fallback: No make-up workload; no change request.
rules.source: Beginner programmes permit repetition contextually; exact RunSensei action requires review.

rules.when: One difficult outcome is present without a repeated pattern.
rules.fallback: No progression or decline inference from one observation.

rules.when: Every scheduled outcome is completed, no warnings/holds exist, and the authored next stage is available.
rules.fallback: Only a reviewed System B/C proposal may materialize a next stage.

evidence.use: Three weekly sessions and pacing at an individual's level; does not validate RunSensei decision thresholds.
Specific load/injury relationships are inconsistent; supports cautious review, not universal adaptation formulas.

notes: Draft-only decision policy. Passing tests does not establish coaching safety. No decision can alter or activate a plan.
